releases.name: Crimson Moon
releases.summary: Crimson Moon is a Gothic High Renaissance action-adventure RPG built around intense, replayable missions that blend brutal precision with deep character progression. Set in the besieged city of Gildenarch, players hack and slash their way through cathedrals, battlements, and shadowed districts overrun by demons, vampires, and undead gods. Players can venture alone or bring a friend in optional co-op as they wield angelic power and fight back the Infernal Legion.

releases.name: Serious Sam: Shatterverse
releases.summary: Serious Sam: Shatterverse is a co-op roguelite FPS for 1 - 5 players. Blast through shifting universes, stack wild boons, bend the rules with run modifiers, and hunt Mental's deadliest forces. Fall fast. Come back louder.

releases.name: Lady Death Demonicron
releases.summary: WordZone is het nieuwe Nederlandse online-woordspel, waarmee je je Facebook-vrienden en andere tegenstanders kunt verslaan en topscorer kunt worden!Het gaat erom hoe handig en creatief je woorden legt.Je maakt daarbij gebruik van de Van Dale Taalspelwoordenlijst, de meest uitgebreide woordenlijst Nederlands, speciaal ontwikkeld voor taalspelletjes!Spelkenmerken:• ELO-rating en topscorelijsten• Je speelt tegen je Facebook-vrienden en je kunt je gewonnen en verloren partijen bijhouden• Je speelt tegen willekeurige spelers op je eigen niveau• Je kunt tijdens het spel chatten met je vrienden en tegenstanders• Van Dale Taalspelwoordenlijst, de meest uitgebreide woordenlijst Nederlands, speciaal ontwikkeld voor taalspelletjes• Omvangrijke woordenlijsten in veel andere talen• Woorden die niet in de woordenlijst staan, mogen door je tegenstander goedgekeurd worden• Er zijn 5 verschillende borden: Standaard, Random, Blanco, Blue Heaven en Diagonale Bonus• Je kunt een onbeperkt aantal partijen tegelijk spelenBeschikbare talen:• Deens (Gyldendal)• Duits• Engels (internationaal)• Engels (Amerikaans)• Faeröers• Fins• Frans• Groenlands• IJslands• Italiaans• Nederlands (Van Dale)• Noors (Bokmål)• Noors (Nynorsk)• Pools• Portugees (Brazilië)• Portugees (Portugal)• Roemeens• Spaans• ZweedsSpelregels:• WordZone is een online-woordspel voor 2 spelers.• Je kiest een van je vrienden als tegenstander of je laat de app iemand vinden op je eigen spelniveau.• Je krijgt 7 letters met een verschillende waarde. Je wint punten door daarmee woorden te leggen op een bord met vakjes. Eigennamen en de meeste afkortingen mogen niet.• Degene met de meeste punten heeft gewonnen!WordZone is ontwikkeld in samenwerking met vooraanstaande Europese woordenboekenmakers, zodat je de beste woordenlijsten tot je beschikking hebt. Er komen regelmatig nieuwe talen bij!

releases.name: Wishing Well Simulator
releases.summary: [h2]You cannot move. You cannot speak. You can only choose.[/h2]You are a stone wishing well in a small seaside town. People lean over your edge, toss a coin, and whisper what they want most. Granting is your only voice — and your water is not endless.[h2]Every wish has a price[/h2]Eight townspeople return to you, day after day, for eight days. The merchant asks for a horse; days later he buys the field that fed the girl who greets you every morning. The game never blames you. It only shows you what you did — in the same faces, in the same square, one day later.[h2]Features[/h2][list][*] 119 handwritten events across 8 days — each one someone's wish, or its consequence[*] 8 characters whose fates intertwine: what you give one, you quietly take from another[*] 4 endings, decided by the kind of well you chose to be[*] The town remembers: choices persist and come back as props, lines and faces[*] Two buttons: grant or refuse. (And one more, to skip.)[*] A living square from dawn to dusk — visitors arrive with the sun[*] One run: 70–80 minutes. Seeing everything: about four runs.[*] Full controller support · playable in 22 languages[/list][h2]Who is the well when the water runs low?[/h2]Some wishes feed your depths; some drain them. Hold everything back and be forgotten. Give everything away and watch the town devour itself. Four ends of the same rope — and none of them is called "right".

releases.name: Tank Odyssey
releases.summary: Enter fast-paced tank arenas where sharp movement and quick decisions are the keys to survival. Fight relentless enemies, switch between four distinct weapons and take on a new challenge in every level - hunt for hidden keys, capture zones, complete time trials and more!Battle through 20 increasingly difficult levels across the Arcade, Void, Paper and Distort arenas, then test your skills in four objective-free Endless modes. Stay mobile, master every weapon and survive the chaos in Tank Odyssey.

releases.name: Vampire Survivors: Legacy of the Blood Moon
releases.summary:
In ancient times, Saint Baal'Thasar had a vision of paradise, lit by a bright, red moon. And so he founded the Order of the Red Moon, to lead people to a land of eternal life. The myth says that Baal'Thasar found his paradise during a pilgrimage, and so never returned.

Having lost its leader, the Order shattered and many fringe sects were born from its remnants. Today, members of one of the most unscrupulous cults, Clan Bloodmoon, embarks on a journey to follow in Baal'Thasar's footsteps...

releases.name: Captain Tsubasa 2: World Fighters
releases.summary:
The next episode of Tsubasa’s riveting adventure is here! Enjoy the thrill of spectacular soccer actions with 110 playable characters and new sensational super moves. 

CAPTAIN TSUBASA 2: WOLRD FIGHTERS invites fans to follow their journey to victory by creating their own character and joining Tsubasa on his quest. Players will forge new friendships, fight new rivals, and bring the trophy back home.

Action on the field has been significantly enhanced for this new release. New super moves increase the intensity of every part of the game, allowing players to dominate the field when they pass, dribble, tackle or block with their own special techniques.

Even blocking goal shots becomes more tactical with a new system that pits goalkeeper against shooter, letting both players experience and counter jaw dropping super shots and blocks from characters of the original series.

releases.name: Iridio
releases.summary:
Seized by criminals, the island designated for your research needs your help.

Join Yatziri and the Wazhari tribe to liberate their hostages, explore hidden secrets, craft essential items and weapons, and strategically use fire and water in challenging puzzles and life-or-death battles for survival.

releases.name: Animal Shelter 2
releases.summary: U-Boot Plus is a very enjoyable side-scrolling submarine game. Navigate your submarine by tilting your iPhone (or iPod Touch). Use controls on the bottom to shoot torpedoes or to control your speed. Avoid dangerous obstacles (mines, jellyfish, enemy submarines,...). Collect bonuses and power-ups (stars, shields, propellers, torpedoes,...). There are three game types and many levels. U-Boot Plus is a fun game. Enjoy our game!

releases.name: Cozy Farm Life Simulator
releases.summary: Cooking Dash delivers fast-paced, addicting fun that is optimized for playing on-the-go. Keep customers happy by prepping everything from burgers and fries to sushi and dumplings. Tap and slide to seat customers, serve up hot dishes, and collect big tips! Help our heroine Flo keep 6 DinerTown restaurants up and running... if you can stand the heat!

releases.name: Star Wars Zero Company
releases.summary: Command an elite squad through a gritty and authentic story in STAR WARS Zero Company™, a single-player turn-based tactics game set in the twilight of the Clone Wars™. You will step into the shoes of Hawks, a former Republic officer who leads Zero Company as they are recruited for an operation that pits them against an emerging threat that will consume the galaxy if left unchecked.

releases.name: Aggelos 2
releases.summary:
Jump into an action-packed 2D retro Metroidvania adventure where reactive combat, smart exploration and powerful polarising abilities collide.

Aggelos 2 is a full evolution of the original, now thrusting the visuals into the 16-bit era. Its transformational twist takes the gameplay to another level, as the world now exists in two overlapping realms: Light and Darkness.

You are an Aggelos - the highest rank among the angels - as the gods face imminent defeat at the hands of the Army of Darkness, you are sent on an epic journey by Balro through Lumen, the domain of the supreme god of light. With Lumen under siege, you must battle through the chaos in both the Light and Dark worlds layered over one another. Both filled with challenging enemies, twisting paths, and thought-provoking puzzles. Shifting between realms is key to your survival and progress.

releases.name: Golftacular!
releases.summary: Daemon Amor (the love demon) has taken over Cupid's job! Help Amor spread the love!* Dodge obstacles while delivering heartwarming valentines to the sad sacks of sorrow!* Activate a score multiplier through consecutive direct hits!* Game Center enabled with leader boards and 23 achievements!

releases.name: Ghetto Zombies: Graffiti Squad
releases.summary:
Ghetto Zombies is an intense pixel art action shooter where you take control of different heroes from an elite squad to face hordes of zombies and eccentric creatures.

Armed to the teeth with quirky weapons - like ketchup pistols, bubble gum launchers, and water guns - you'll explore a chaotic city, showcase your art with graffiti, defeat challenging bosses, and hunt for the cure to the epidemic!

releases.name: Horripilant
releases.summary: ***Peg the Customers with Donuts before they enter Donut World!!*** Game Features: -Throw Different kinds of donuts including Glazed, Jelly, Crème filled, and Donut Holes -Earn a Slingshot and Donut Hole Machine Gun! -Close out each day by Pegging your final Wave of Customers -Earn Donut Coins and Power ups with Headshots and Completed Objectives -Simple Flick and Tilt controls that are easy to use -Game Center Leaderboard -Complete Objective List to Compete with your Friends -Amazing HD Retina Graphics All was good in the ‘hood, until the Donutski family’s Donut Shop is overpowered by the big, bad Donut World that shoots up next door. The Donutski family, saddened and maddened by losing their customers to these corporate bullies, decides to get even, one donut at a time! SPLAT, SPLOOSH, SPLASH! Mama and Papa D. take their surplus of donuts to the streets, and begin chucking them at any unsuspecting fool trying to enter the Donut World. If Mama and Papa ain’t happy, ain’t nobody happy! ***Regular Content Updates with New Levels, Characters, and Weapons coming soon!!*** Imagine taking a leisurely stroll down the street one day, only to get nailed in face by a gooey DONUT!! Well, lucky for you, you get to be the one doing the throwing! You start with 3 lives, and will earn points for each person you wallop with a donut. Extra Donut Coins will be awarded for head shots. You lose a life if you hit a safe citizen. That is, a police officer, an old woman, a woman with a stroller, or a priest. Hey, you gotta draw the line somewhere, right? New board settings will be made available as coin goals are reached. You can earn a donut gun or sling shot for high score play, as well as better ammunition. If you think popping somebody in the face with a glazed donut is nasty, try doing it with a powdered, jelly, creme-filled, or bear claw donut. Better yet, go for GOLD and gain a donut hole machine gun and see what happens. Can you say Game Changer !?! So, there you have it. Donut Wars! Get the high score, be a hero, and brag to your friends. **Featured on AppAdvice.com in AppsGoneFree. releases.name: The Immortal John Triptych
releases.summary:
Immortal John is dying. A holy war has ended in chaos. Sin itself demands reckoning. Three interconnected tales unfold across a world built from Renaissance paintings and Classical music, where the ridiculous and the profound collide. 

Help locals with their daily tasks, only to find the Devil lurking in the shadows. Chase a tyrant across kingdoms while assisting inept magicians and negotiating with God Almighty. Navigate sin, death, judgement, heaven and hell, all topped with a cherry of gleeful flippancy. 

From quiet countryside kindness spiraling into madness, to holy vengeance wrapped in absurdity, to cosmic philosophy delivered with a wink and a nudge, The Immortal John Triptych proves that the most intelligent thing you can do is embrace the utterly ridiculous.
